meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney
meta.description: Bike servicing, same-day puncture and brake fixes, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney.

rationale: A workshop in a railway arch wants the clarity of a workshop sign: white ground, one signal red, heavy Archivo type and hard rules, with numbers doing the decoration. A big type poster opens the page, an oversized numbered index shows the four jobs, and a plain price ledger answers the question couriers ask first. Nothing is soft or ornamental, because the trade is not.

items.a: No. You can book a service online or just turn up. Booking guarantees a slot on busy days.

items.q: Can you fix a puncture while I wait?
items.a: Yes. Punctures and brake fixes are done while you wait.

items.q: I need my bike back today. Is that possible?
items.a: Usually, yes. Many of our customers are couriers and commuters, so we plan around same-day returns. Tell us when you book.

items.q: Do you work on old steel bikes?
items.a: Gladly. Restoring old steel frames is our favourite job.
